signals.source_text: He was sitting in meditation, his awareness extended through the quantum foam that connected all existence, when he felt the first tentative touch of another consciousness seeking contact.
I am here, he responded, his consciousness flowing through quantum channels toward the source of the contact.
Someone who had survived the transformation by developing magical abilities through pure instinct, but who lacked the framework to understand what they had become.

As he waited for the student to arrive, the Sage felt Torrhen's presence threading through the wind and water around him—not words, but harmonic patterns that spoke of approval, of love that transcended individual existence, of friendship that had become part of the quantum structure of reality itself.
